newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly unchanged Monday in the wake of CFTC's Commitments of Traders Report released after the close Friday, dealers said.
The report showed the speculators to be holding a 44.28 percent net long position, or 69,531 contracts out of a total open interest of 157,010 contracts.
Friday, most-active July finished 0.04 cent firmer at 11.41 cents a lb after trading from 11.54 to 11.37 cents. October closed 0.05 cent higher at 11.26, and the back months settled 0.04 cent higher.
An estimated 17,606 lots changed hands on the day.

In London, white sugar futures were mostly unchanged on Monday, as players awaited inspiration from the New York market. At 0848 EDT/1248 GMT, LIFFE spot August contract was unchanged at $326.00. The rest of the board stood unchanged to $0.50 higher.
